caption_L1: This is a line chart titled Austria : Infant mortality rate from 2009 to 2019 (in deaths per 1,000 live births). Deaths per 1,000 live births is plotted along the y-axis. There is a linear scale of range 2010 to 2018 along the x-axis, labeled Year.
caption_L2L3: The line graph shows a gentle downward trend or decline in the infant mortality rate from 2009 to 2019 for Austria.  For example, in 2010, there were just under 4 deaths per 1000 live births and this decreased steadily to 3 deaths per 1000 live births in 2016 and finally to just under 3 deaths per 1000 live births in Austria in 2018.
